content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission, records submission, patient billing beyond contractual liability, or write-off would not properly resolve the denial. Escalation is the only available path that may identify a payer-specific authorization exception or further appeal right before filing limits expire."}
